raw_user_query: Explain about the CJP protest in detail?

orchestrator_output.reformulated_query: Detailed explanation of Cockroach Janta Party CJP student protests in India
orchestrator_output.text_narration: The Cockroach Janta Party, known as CJP, started in mid-2026 as a youth-led social movement in India. It began on social media as a satirical group created by young people to express their feelings about student issues. The protest started mainly due to two main reasons. First, students were upset over exam paper leaks in major national competitive tests. Second, young people wanted fair rules, better job opportunities, and accountability in conducting public examinations. The movement grew step-by-step. It started online in May 2026, moved to peaceful gatherings in New Delhi in June 2026, gained national attention through public discussions, and led to official dialogues regarding exam reforms in July 2026. This movement shows how young citizens in a democracy can use peaceful expression to raise concerns about education and exam systems. It highlights the importance of fair opportunities and active civic participation for a better future.
